title: Modern Treasury square button
description: Near-square fintech buttons (2px corners): a solid ink fill, a 1px ink outline, and a bold text link, each with an optional arrow that nudges 2px right on hover.
notes: arrow nudge is 150ms; off with reduced motion
name: moderntreasury-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: ink fill · outline: 1px ink ring on the page colour · link: bold text, no box

props.name: size
props.description: xs: 32px, 13px bold (inside cards) · sm: 32px, 14px (header) · md: 40px, 16px (hero, forms)

props.name: arrow
props.description: a small arrow after the label that moves right on hover

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
